description:
Offline ANC / HearThrough switcher and battery monitor for Jabra Elite 10 A minimal, fully offline replacement for the Jabra Sound+ app, built around the one feature that matters most: switching between Noise Cancelling, HearThrough and Off. The earbud button already cycles those modes — as long as you are wearing the left bud. Listening with only the right one, in bed for instance, leaves no way to switch. That is what this app is for, and why it ships a Quick Settings tile: pull down the shade, one tap cycles the modes. It works on the lock screen, so you never have to open the app at all. Features
  • Switch Noise Cancelling / HearThrough / Off, from the app or a Quick Settings tile
  • Shows all three battery levels separately: left bud, right bud and charging case
  • Picks up mode changes you make with the earbud button
  • Reconnects on its own when you take the buds out of the case
  • Says plainly when the buds are not reachable instead of pretending
  • English and German
Offline by design The app has no INTERNET permission at all — not an unused one, none. It cannot phone home, there is no account, no tracking, no Google Play Services, and no analytics. It talks to the earbuds over Bluetooth and to nothing else. That is also why there is no firmware updater: even a passive update check would need network access, and that would defeat the point. How it works The Elite 10 talks to Sound+ over Bluetooth Classic RFCOMM, using a protocol that was reverse-engineered from a capture of the phone's own Bluetooth traffic. The findings are documented in the project's README so anyone can check what the app does, or build on it. Device support Everything here was developed and tested against one single pair of Jabra Elite 10. It may work on other Jabra earbuds that speak the same protocol, and it may equally well not: other generations use different transports and different identifiers. If it does not work with yours, the app has a Diagnostics section that exports a protocol log — open an issue with that log and the exact model, and support can be added. Not affiliated with Jabra or GN Audio.
